findings.body: The standard requires “Forge shrinks over time” and a “refactor ratchet in CI.” This finding remains open: the current src/forge/*.py files total 8,542 lines, exceeding the unchanged 8,500-line ceiling at pyproject.toml:40. tests/test_rules.py:67 enforces that ceiling, and the supplied close run confirms the failure. Reduce actual code or process enough to pass the existing check; joining lines or removing blank lines does not satisfy the standard.
findings.title: Standard: Forge shrinks over time
